units.source_text: “这样的姑娘，有哪一点好呢？”驹子有点哽咽，

en.t: What is there to like about a girl like that? Komako said, her voice catching slightly,

units.source_text: “头一回见你时，感到你这个人讨厌。

en.t: When I first met you, I thought you were an unpleasant person.

units.source_text: 哪有人讲话像你这样冒失的。

en.t: No one talks as rashly as you do.

units.source_text: 我当时觉得你真讨厌呐。”

en.t: At the time, I really thought you were hateful.
